cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a small present-day optical-illusion theatre with burgundy curtains and a brightly lit empty demonstration stage — enjoying a stage-magic rehearsal; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small balcony with potted plants — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; inside a general's command tent — sitting on the ground; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing with one foot up on a step; a bus shelter on a quiet street — standing; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — carries her keepsake low at her side
